source_name: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve (MFPT) — National AML/CFT Strategy and action plan
why_relevant: The FIU sits under the Ministry of Finance; MFPT publishes the Strategjia Kombëtare against money laundering/terrorist financing with a dated action plan. Those action-plan milestones are the government-side deadlines that translate PECK/EU recommendations into national obligations, and MFPT also runs the appointment of the FIU Director.

source_name: European Commission — Kosovo Enlargement Report (annual SWD), Chapter 24 AML/CFT and CFSP sanctions alignment
why_relevant: Annual, dated, and explicitly evaluative: assesses FIU capacity, AML law status (the 2025 report notes the adopted AML/CFT law was pending Constitutional Court review on procedural grounds), supervisory information exchange, and degree of alignment with EU restrictive measures. Highly predictive of the next legislative push and its timing.

source_name: European Parliament — reports/resolutions on the Commission Reports on Kosovo (oeil / doceo)
why_relevant: EP resolutions restate and sharpen AML/financial-crime demands on Kosovo and are a pointer into the legislative-observatory trail; useful as a secondary confirmation and for spotting which AML shortcomings are politically salient.

source_name: Law No. 08/L-265 on the Register of Beneficial Owners + ARBK business registry
why_relevant: Beneficial-ownership registration is a hard AML compliance obligation with filing deadlines for legal persons, and banks depend on the register for CDD. Law 08/L-265 is listed on the FIU legislation page; the Kosovo Business Registration Agency (ARBK) is the operating registry. Historic PECK findings noted the absence of a BO register, so build-out milestones are trackable.

source_name: UNDP Kosovo — Money laundering typologies for Kosovo (Tipologjitë e pastrimit të parave)
why_relevant: Donor-produced typology material developed with/for Kosovo authorities; useful for understanding what predicate-offence patterns the FIU expects banks to detect, and as evidence of the technical-assistance pipeline that usually precedes new FIU guidance.

source_name: Group for Legal and Political Studies (GLPS) — AML monitoring reports on Kosovo
why_relevant: Independent Prishtina think tank publishing monitoring of Kosovo's AML programme and institutions (e.g. 'Lufta kundër pastrimit të parave', 2019; ABR/AML monitoring findings, 2025). Provides critical, non-official assessment of whether FIU obligations and deadlines are actually enforced — the counterweight to official self-reporting.

source_name: Kallxo.com / BIRN Kosovo — investigative reporting on sanctions and financial measures
why_relevant: BIRN's Kosovo outlet reports early and specifically on financial/restrictive measures affecting Kosovo (e.g. confirmation of the lifting of EU financial measures) and on money-laundering prosecutions. Fastest local signal that a sanctions or enforcement change has occurred, ahead of official publication.

source_name: EU Official Journal / EUR-Lex — restrictive measures and the AML package (AMLR/AMLD6/AMLA)
why_relevant: The FIU's own sanctions page declares that only the EU Official Journal and UNSC listings are authentic, so EUR-Lex is the upstream of truth for the EU list Kosovo republishes. Separately, the EU AML package (applicable from 2027) is the template Kosovo's amending law will be aligned to, making it a leading indicator of forthcoming Kosovo obligations.

source_name: Kosovo AML/CFT law full text mirrors (Smart Balkans, secondary hosts)
why_relevant: Useful fallback text of Law 05/L-096 when the gazette's ASP.NET pages are awkward to fetch, and a way to snapshot the pre-amendment consolidated version. Must never be treated as authoritative over gzk.rks-gov.net.

source_name: FIU-K operational domain fic-ks.org (email + goAML host, distinct from fiu.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: The FIU operates on two domains: the public fiu.rks-gov.net site and the operational fic-ks.org (contact email fic@fic-ks.org, goAML at report.fic-ks.org). Knowing this second domain matters for discovery — some notices, forms and older documents may live there rather than on the .rks-gov.net site.

source_name: Administrata Tatimore e Kosovës (ATK) — official site (Legjislacioni / Njoftime)
why_relevant: Primary rule-maker and operator for fiscalization in Kosovo: publishes fiscal-device technical specifications, certification requirements for PEF/SEF providers, taxpayer notices with hard deadlines, and the legislation library (laws + udhëzime administrative) in sq/sr/en. Directly binding on POS/terminal and cash-handling vendors.

source_name: ATK SEF certification application portal (Aplikimi për Softuerë Elektronikë Fiskalë)
why_relevant: The live application/certification gateway for economic operators wanting to supply Electronic Fiscal Software (SEF). Reveals certification criteria, technical integration docs, and — critically for a terminal vendor — who is entering the certified-supplier market and when application windows open/close.

source_name: ATK EDI — electronic declaration system (incl. "Kërkesë për Fiskalizim" service)
why_relevant: EDI is the operational channel through which the Unique Fiscalization Code is issued — a precondition for using SEF and for transitioning from PEF to SEF under UA (MF) Nr. 01/2026. Release notes on EDI versions are an early indicator of mandated integration changes for POS software.

source_name: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve (MFPT) — official site
why_relevant: The Minister of Finance signs the administrative instructions that bind fiscal-device use (e.g. UA (MF) Nr. 01/2026), and the ministry announces certification windows for digital fiscal register providers. Also the parent of both ATK and Kosovo Customs.

source_name: Dogana e Kosovës (Kosovo Customs) — official site
why_relevant: Controls importation of payments hardware (POS terminals, fiscal printers, ATM/cash-handling equipment): tariff classification, import duty/VAT at import, temporary-import regimes, restricted-goods lists and ASYCUDA declaration rules. Binding cost and lead-time driver for a terminal business, and outside CBK's remit.

source_name: ATK legislation library in Serbian (Legjislacioni tatimor i Kosovës në gjuhën serbe)
why_relevant: Confirms ATK publishes its tax legislation corpus in Serbian, giving a second-language entry point (poreska administracija, fiskalne kase, pravilnik) for monitoring and for serving Serb-majority municipalities. Useful for glossary building and for catching sr-only republications.

source_name: ATK fiscal-device functional and technical specifications (PDF series)
why_relevant: The actual conformance spec a device or POS integration must meet to be certified in Kosovo — requirements, functional and technical characteristics of electronic fiscal devices. Successive editions (Mars 2014, Qershor 2015, and any SEF-era replacement) are the engineering-level requirement baseline.

source_name: Buletini Ekonomik — Kosovo economic/business news outlet
why_relevant: Sustained, specific reporting on the fiscal-register market: certification application windows, the PEF-to-SEF digitalization rollout, business confusion over deadlines, and multi-year investigative coverage of the licensed fiscal-device supplier concentration (Gekos, Dukagjini, Enternet, Service Global). Best single pointer to competitive and licensing dynamics that ATK does not narrate.

source_name: Radio Evropa e Lirë (RFE/RL Kosovo) — fiscal-device rule explainers
why_relevant: Produces plain-language breakdowns of what a given udhëzim administrativ actually obliges (roles of producers, developers, authorized sellers, taxpayers; receipt-retention rules; real-time reporting to ATK). Useful as a corroborating interpretation layer and to detect politically contentious provisions.

source_name: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës (Kosovo Chamber of Commerce)
why_relevant: Organised private-sector counterparty to MFPT/ATK on fiscalization: publicly objected to not being consulted on UA Nr. 01/2026 and demanded compensation for superseded fiscal registers. Its publications and position papers are an early signal of deadline slippage, transitional relief, and implementation friction.

source_name: Kontabiliteti-ks.com — Kosovo accounting practitioner portal
why_relevant: Practitioner-facing commentary on fiscal-register obligations, pricing and market concentration. Accountants are the first to feel a new administrative instruction; their community write-ups often surface effective dates and practical compliance steps before official FAQ pages exist.

source_name: Certified/commercial fiscal-solution vendor sites (Klikont, Arka Fiskale, Arka Digjitale)
why_relevant: Competitor/market-participant sources that reveal-indirectly: they document in practical detail what ATK-certified integration requires (NUF, QR-code verification, real-time registration), current device categories and price points, and how quickly vendors adapt to a new instruction. Effectively a live read on the certified-supplier landscape a terminal business would compete or partner with.

source_name: CEFTA Transparency Trade Portal — Kosovo (XK) section
why_relevant: Aggregator that consolidates Kosovo import procedures, required documents and the legal bases behind them, with links back to Kosovo Customs instruments. Useful as an English-language index into customs rules governing importation of payments hardware, and to catch procedural changes without reading the customs site directly.

source_name: ATK tax legislation compendia (Libri i Ligjeve / Doracaku i TVSH-së)
why_relevant: Consolidated law-and-instruction books and VAT handbooks published by ATK; they bundle the tax-procedure law, VAT law and their implementing administrative instructions, including e-invoice obligations for internet supplies (UA Nr. 02/2018 on use of electronic devices and fiscal systems). Convenient authoritative baseline text.

source_name: Kosovo general-news wires covering ATK/MF announcements (Telegrafi, KosovaPress, Ekonomia Online, Bota Sot, Zëri)
why_relevant: High-frequency, low-latency republication of ATK and MFPT press notices — often the fastest public signal that a new fiscalization service, instruction or deadline has landed, and they reach the reader when the ATK site itself is slow or fetch-hostile. Use for timing detection, not for legal text.

source_name: Scribd-hosted copies of Kosovo fiscal administrative instructions
why_relevant: Mirror of UA (MFPT) Nr. 01/2025 on the use of electronic fiscal devices, fiscal systems and electronic fiscal software — useful as a fallback when the official PDF is hard to reach, and as evidence that the 2025 instrument preceded the 2026 one. Not authoritative: always reconcile against GZK.

source_name: Autoriteti Kosovar i Konkurrencës (AKK) — official site
why_relevant: Kosovo's competition regulator; the body that would rule on interbank/interchange fee arrangements, bank fee cartels, bancassurance tying and payment-scheme concentrations. Its decisions bind banks and PSPs independently of the central bank.
